cells.title: Warn in bee test when a shared cargo target meets a live worker elsewhere
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- verbs::test_runner herding::wave_ledger

truths: a pure function in test_runner.rs takes the CARGO_TARGET_DIR value, the tested checkout path and the live workers' checkout paths and returns the warning text or None
it returns None when the value is unset or empty, when the target resolves inside the checkout, or when every live worker checkout is the tested checkout
the warning names the target dir and each other checkout and says a red may be false
run() prints the warning to stderr before the suite runs, adds shared_target_warning to the --json result, and still runs and records the suite
a pub(crate) helper in wave_ledger.rs lists the worktree of every unresolved worker in waves younger than DEFAULT_STALE_AFTER_MS, read from the control root

cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/wave_ledger.rs add pub(crate) fn live_worker_worktrees(root: &Path, now_ms: i64, stale_after_ms: i64) -> Vec<String> over fold_waves_by_wave_id (line 227) and is_live (line 208): the worktree of each worker with outcome None in a live row. In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/test_runner.rs add a pure fn shared_target_warning(target_dir: Option<&str>, checkout: &Path, live_worktrees: &[String]) -> Option<String>: None when target_dir is None or blank, when the target (canonicalized when it exists, else lexical) is inside the canonical checkout, or when no live worktree differs from the checkout after canonicalizing both; otherwise one line shaped: warning: CARGO_TARGET_DIR <dir> is shared, and the wave ledger counts a live worker in <checkout list>; a build there can replace binaries under this suite, so a red here may be false. FIX: wait for those workers, or re-run with a private CARGO_TARGET_DIR. In run() (line 80), when commands are declared and before run_declared_tests, read CARGO_TARGET_DIR from the environment, read the live worktrees from the control root (resolve it the way bee herding occupancy finds the ledger; a linked worktree reads main's .bee/wave-ledger.jsonl), print the warning to stderr if Some, and insert shared_target_warning into the result map. The suite still runs. Write no tests (stw-2 owns them) and no code comment. Commit once (cell trailer). Proof: the verify command.

cells.title: Prove the shared target warning red then green

truths: a test shows shared_target_warning returns a line naming the dir and the other checkout when the target is outside the checkout and a live worker is elsewhere
tests show None for an unset value, a blank value, a target inside the checkout, and live workers only in the same checkout
a test shows live_worker_worktrees lists unresolved workers of a fresh wave and skips resolved workers and waves older than the stale window
every new test name contains shared_target
a test was run against the stw-1 parent commit and failed or did not compile there, and the report quotes it
the report under docs/history/shared-target-warning/reports/ quotes each run's result line

cells.action: Check contract shared-target-warning (decision 6fd09277) on the stw-1 commit. Add tests to the existing tests modules: test_runner.rs (mod tests near line 423) for shared_target_warning, all five cases, using tempdirs for real paths; wave_ledger.rs tests for live_worker_worktrees with a fixture .bee/wave-ledger.jsonl (fresh unresolved, fresh resolved, stale unresolved). Every test name contains shared_target. Red proof: run the verify with the production files at the stw-1 parent (git show <parent>:<path> into the tree), record the failure or compile error, restore both files to HEAD, confirm git status shows them clean apart from your test edits. Then run the verify green. Edit no production code outside the tests modules. Write docs/history/shared-target-warning/reports/stw-2.md with each run and its result line. Commit once (cell trailer).
